SELECT /*LGVATT00014.retrieveBonusKpiForOs*/ kbo.PAY_ROLL_KPI_BONUS_ID ,kbo.NO ,kbo.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM ,kbo.STATUS ,kbo.VENDOR_CODE ,kbo.RECUITIMENT_TAGET ,kbo.RECUITIMENT_ACTUAL ,kbo.KPI_RATE ,kbo.KPI_BONUS ,(select local_language_full_name from lgcom_user_m where application_user_id = kbo.creation_user_id) as creation_user_id /* 등록자ID */ ,TO_CHAR(kbo.creation_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as creation_date /* 등록일자 */ FROM TB_PAY_KPI_BONUS_OS kbo WHERE 1 = 1
AND (UPPER(kbo.VENDOR_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{vendorName}) || '%')
AND (kbo.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM) = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}
ORDER BY kbo.VENDOR_CODE asc
